_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Sunday — quiet news day that consolidates Saturday's institutional-stress thread into a coherent framing: The Neuron's weekend digest brands the arc 'AI is outgrowing its institutions' — the gloss the rest of W15 (Mythos Apr 7, Bessent/Powell Apr 14, BoE Apr 11) lines up against. MAD Bugs cumulative count doubles Sat→Sun to ~1,000 validated high-severity vulns. Google AI Studio ships annotate/focus + Firebase integration + 'Feeling Lucky' screenshot-to-app — Gemini developer-onboarding moat. Block donates Goose to AAIF — AAIF now anchors MCP + AGENTS.md + Goose as the open-source counterweight to NVIDIA Agent Toolkit + Microsoft Agent Framework. Single-Agent LLMs Outperform Multi-Agent paper (Tran/Kiela) lands as the empirical corrective to the 'more agents = better' Copilot Studio framing. Waymo + WeRide robotaxi airport / Dubai expansions add the AV-economics thread. No new topic spawns today; autonomous-cyber-capability extends slow EMA; open-vs-closed adds Kimi K2.5-in-Claude-Code data point.

sectors.name: Agents & infrastructure
sectors.description: Sunday consolidates Saturday's harness-narrative compounding into a single open-standards counter-move: Block donates Goose to AAIF, joining MCP + AGENTS.md as Linux-Foundation-governed anchors. NVIDIA Agent Toolkit and Microsoft Agent Framework remain the vendor-stack rivals. Single-Agent vs Multi-Agent paper (Tran/Kiela) lands the empirical corrective the same week Microsoft Copilot Studio multi-agent went GA. HERA / Omni-SimpleMem / ASI-Evolve extend the multi-agent-civilisation thread. Kinetic-disruption carries — AWS Gulf recovery; Cloudflare prepares post-quantum response.

sectors.name: Methods & research
sectors.description: DataFlex unified data-centric dynamic training + Single-Agent LLMs vs Multi-Agent paper (information-theoretic + empirical corrective to 'more agents = better') anchor the Sunday research backfill. ICD jailbreak class extends cot-monitorability adversarial frontier. Tex3D adversarial 3D textures break VLA agents.

sectors.name: Models & capabilities
sectors.description: Mythos disclosure choreography enters T-2 day. MAD Bugs cumulative running total to ~1,000 validated vulns by end of weekend — empirical anchor Anthropic's pre-Mythos briefings cite privately. Kimi K2.5-in-Claude-Code drop-in deepens; Joe Njenga's ~8× cost saving piece is the practitioner anchor. Open-weight wave still anchored by Llama / Qwen / GLM.

MAD Bugs cumulative ~1,000 vulns hardens autonomous-cyber. openai-governance-continuity carries from Saturday's Simo medical leave + COO reshuffle. science-verticalisation carries from Anthropic ~$400M biotech.
